findings.title: Call to non-existent no-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() — module does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() now calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the only such method defined in the class hierarchy (UsernamePasswordForm, line 160) is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`, which takes a parameter. Neither AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator nor any other shown class defines a no-arg overload. As shipped, this file will not compile, breaking the whole services module build. Either a no-arg overload (e.g. `webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled()`) is missing from UsernamePasswordForm, or the call in UsernameForm must pass `context.getUser()`.

findings.title: Conditional passkey UI no longer rendered when no user is set in the context
findings.body: The refactor changed both `authenticate()` and `challenge(context, error, field)` to gate `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)` behind the new `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(user)` helper, which returns false when `context.getUser() == null`. Previously, `fillContextForm` was invoked precisely when the user was NOT already selected (the old comments said 'setup webauthn data when the user is not already selected'). After this change, on a fresh login where no user is in the context, the WebAuthn challenge/attributes (WebAuthnConstants.CHALLENGE, RP_ID, ENABLE_WEBAUTHN_CONDITIONAL_UI, etc.) are no longer set on the login form, so conditional-ui (autofill) passkey login on the initial username/password page is silently disabled. Note that tests in this same PR (e.g. PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.passwordLoginWithNonDiscoverableKey, which asserts the `webauth` form is present on the very first login page before any username is submitted) only pass if some other execution renders the conditional UI; for any deployment where the username/password form itself was the sole provider of the conditional passkey UI for unidentified users, this is a functional regression. If the intent was only to also enable it during re-authentication, the user==null case must be preserved, not dropped.
